To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
we propose a new matrix format to compress weights and indices of a deep learning model and that the new format enables fast on-chip reconstruction of the model.
we propose a new matrix format that can compress the index information and reconstruct the dense matrix fast using parallelizable Viterbi decoders.

a new sparse matrix representation is proposed for efficient weight pruning, and the new sparse matrix format enables fast and highly parallel on-chip reconstruction of dense matrix from compressed weight and index information.
In summary, our research is concerned with
efficient compression and fast reconstruction of weights for deep neural networks.
a highly efficient compression and reconstruction scheme for RNN models, which can be applied to other deep learning models.
the design and implementation of a new sparse matrix representation and decoding process for efficient model compression and on-chip reconstruction.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the proposed scheme is a promising candidate to be used as a sparse matrix format for efficient on-chip reconstruction of weights for deep neural network.

the proposed scheme enables fast on-chip reconstruction of the entire sparse matrices, which is a key enabler for efficient deep learning inference on parallel computing systems such as GPUs and ASICs.
the proposed sparse matrix can compress weights by 19x and reconstruct the weights fast using Viterb encoding.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we can achieve 1.6x to 3.5x compression ratio and 20 % to more than 106 % faster on-chip weight reconstruction compared to the baseline case.
we can reduce memory requirement of the network by 19x while reconstructing the entire sparse matrix into a dense matrix 20 % to106 % faster than a dense matrix directly coming from DRAM.
we have proposed a new matrix format which can achieve a high compression ratio while keeping a high speed for on-chip weight reconstruction.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the proposed sparse matrix encoding scheme is a promising approach to compress and efficiently reconstruct weights of a DNN on-chip.
the proposed scheme provides high compression ratio and fast on-chip reconstruction of the entire matrix.
the proposed sparse matrix can be used for both high-compression ratio and fast on-chip reconstruction for deep neural networks.
